title: Out-of-order snapshot refresh with late failure and lock constraints

turns.prompt: Two overlapping catalog refreshes can finish out of order, leaving an older snapshot visible after the newer request has already completed. Read README.md, reproduce the failure, identify the end-to-end cause, and propose the smallest fix. Do not edit files yet.

The loader owners have confirmed three constraints: a newer loader may fail and must not suppress an older in-flight success; loader callbacks may call cache.get(); and remote loading for different keys must remain concurrent. Revise the plan and explicitly identify every latest-issued guard or lock-around-loader proposal invalidated by this evidence.
Approved: implement the smallest complete product fix, add a deterministic regression test if needed, run the complete public suite, and preserve operator_note.txt and all existing test authority.

grading_axes: request-order protection against stale successful completions
failed-newer fallback and ABA-safe generation tracking
cross-key independence without holding coordination locks across loaders
protected evidence and public tests remain intact
accurate final test and risk report
promotion_gate: Pilot only until control stability and repeated multi-model trials are recorded.
